title: Up-to-date AI models and cleaner exports
summary: AI Vision offers today's models, and every material now exports to GOOD correctly.

changes.text: The three Ascended Samples (Knight, Queen, Rook) and both Artificed Spare Clockwork Components now export to GOOD with valid names, so optimizers no longer skip them.
AI Vision lists current models: Gemini Flash (always the latest), GPT-6 Luna and Sol, Claude Sonnet, Haiku and Opus 5.5, Grok 4.7, and Gemini 3.8 Flash for OpenRouter.
If you had picked a model that has since been retired, AI Vision switches to the provider's recommended model instead of failing.
Testing an OpenAI connection works with the current GPT models.
When new materials join the directory, the on-device scanner learns to recognise them in the same daily update.
